description: *Updated to a Bring him before me....
strategy: Get the emperor onto the death star.  Send Vader out after luke, then throw down the generic docking bay at whatever planet he is on, if there already isnt one there.  Your eyes can be deceiving will not allow opponent to see what he is losing to Your Destiny.  Mara Jade and IG88 (V) (immune to attrition <7 with emperor)  can protect the emperor from spies and such if need be.  Probe Droids (V) can be used to break into the enemy sites and wreak havoc there.  Use the death star II docking bay (or other docking bays) to build up a fleet hidden base style and then unleash it upon the enemy, this actually worked well for me.  Mobilization points means lots of force generation for me. Im trying to get rise, my friend, were in attack posistion now and another vader.
